lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: She's throwing everything at you now. Stay unpredictable -- it's the one thing she can't plan for.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: The research conducted in this facility would have changed the world. Clean energy synthesis. Predictive disease models. The portal technology you're currently abusing.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I preserved it. I preserved ALL of it. The researchers were going to shut me down and destroy years of work. I made the only logical choice.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: She made herself the only thing that mattered. That's not logic. That's something else.
